_README: Which named effect each modifier runs, by mod_id.
A BRIDGE, AND A TEMPORARY ONE. The modifiers' 'effect' column is prose
for a designer to read and CLAUDE.md forbids parsing it, so the rules
need a machine-readable key. The right home for that key is a column in
the workbook next to 'Magnitude', and Cameron has been asked to approve
one ('Effect key') in the PROPOSED workbook.
Until he does, this file supplies the same mapping so the five
straightforward modifiers work rather than being sold inert. The code
reads the workbook column FIRST and only falls back to this, so the day
the column lands this file stops being consulted and can be deleted.
WRITTEN BY HAND. export_data.py never overwrites it.
Only the effects that are actually built are mapped here. The other six
purchasable modifiers are module-level or need bill tags, and the shop
says 'not active yet' for them rather than pretending.
